name: gitdoctor
description: Checks your Git Flow and opens the back-merge PR when git proves it safe
about: Runs gitdoctor's read-only checks over main, develop, release and hotfix branches and tags. When main has commits develop never got and git predicts no conflicts, it opens the back-merge pull request for you to merge. A few other mechanical fixes run one by one with your approval; everything else comes with its fix recipe.
features: Find drift across main, develop, releases and tags
Open the back-merge PR only when no conflict is predicted
Apply other fixes one at a time, only with your approval
examplePrompt: Check this repo's git flow and open the back-merge PR if main has commits that develop is missing.
